description: Route public HTTP tunnels, declared deployment, source-context MCP, and shared SonarQube operations to separate provider owners.

modes.intent: Reconcile one approved HTTP or HTTPS Cloudflare tunnel and DNS route.
Execute an imperative deploy or deploy-VPS request for a declared routed product through trusted HTTPS and steady state, or adopt, monitor, recover, or roll it back.
selectionFacts: host release, trusted HTTPS, or steady state

modes.intent: Set up or refresh the Source-wide read-only source-context MCP.
Set up shared SonarQube and reconcile strict quality gates for routed roles.

stops: Source or project routing is unresolved
operation spans more than one provider owner
destructive or publication boundary is undisclosed
request is local development startup or another excluded operation
